To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of ANC scheme in OFDM system is highly sensitive to the PN linewidth value and the PN introduced at the destination is the main factor that degrades the system performance.
ANC scheme is more susceptible to the phase noise introduced during the broadcast than during the multiple access phase.
ANC scheme is more susceptible to the PN at the destination than at relay, and this susceptibility increases as the PN linewidth increases up to 20 Hz.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance evaluation of the ANC scheme in the OFDM based wireless communication networks in the presence of the PN.
the impact of PN on the performance of ANC scheme based OFDM in the frequency-selective fading environment.
the effect of PN in the performance of ANC scheme based OFDM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the ANC scheme based on orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (ANC-OFDM) is a promising technique for bi-directional communication in the presence of moderate phase noise.
the PN is a major performance limiting factor in the ANC scheme based on frequency-selective fading and OFDM, and the PN mitigation techniques are highly required to improve the system’s performance.
the ANC scheme in the OFDM system is more vulnerable to the PN than to the frequency-selective fading.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the performance degradation in the ANC scheme in the frequency-selective fading environment can be reduced by using a low PN linewidth and a high number of subcarriers.
ANC scheme is a robust and reliable scheme for the PN linewidth less than 20 Hz.
the ANC scheme can be a reliable technique to increase the network’s capacity and reliability, even in the presence of moderate PN.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ANC scheme is not robust in the presence of the PN, and thus, the performance of ANC scheme can be significantly degraded by the PN.
the ANC scheme based on orthogonal frequency multiplexing is not suitable in the presence of strong PN.
the ANC protocol is not a suitable solution for the wireless networks with high PN.
